I read AGENTS.md and followed it. It routes this task to `docs/flows/add-endpoint.md`, which uses "rest at the inn" as its worked example. `docs/flows/inventory.md` covers shops and gold. I checked the anchors against the code. I changed no files.

## Worker

1. **`worker/src/types/index.ts`**
   - Add `RestBody { sessionId: string; characterId: string }`.
   - Add a cost constant, e.g. `INN_REST_COST`. The cost is a rule, so it lives in Worker code.
   - `Character` already has `hp`, `max_hp` and `gold` (lines 31–33), so no new fields are needed.

2. **`worker/src/routes/rest.ts`** (new)
   - Export `restRoutes = new Hono<{ Bindings: Env }>()` with `POST /`.
   - Validate the body.
   - Call `getCharacter(db, id)` (`services/character.ts:86`).
   - Return 404 if the character is missing.
   - Return 400 if `gold < cost`, or if `hp === max_hp` so the player isn't charged for nothing.
   - Call `updateCharacter(db, id, { hp: max_hp, gold: gold - cost })` (`services/character.ts:94`). The whitelist already allows `hp` and `gold`, so that function needs no change.
   - Return `{ updatedCharacter, goldSpent }`.
   - Optionally add `appendHistory` and `saveSession`, plus an `adventure_log` insert, following `routes/action.ts`.

3. **`worker/src/index.ts`**
   - Add `import { restRoutes } from './routes/rest.js';` next to lines 5–12.
   - Add `app.route('/api/rest', restRoutes);` in the block at lines 41–48.
   - CORS needs no change, because POST is already allowed.

4. **`worker/migrations/`**
   - No new migration is needed: HP and gold are existing columns.
   - Don't edit `0001`.

## Frontend

5. **`frontend/src/app/models/game.models.ts`**
   - Add a `RestResponse { updatedCharacter: Character; goldSpent: number }` interface. The existing `updatedCharacter: Character` fields are at lines 100 and 116.

6. **`frontend/src/app/services/game-api.service.ts`**
   - Add `rest(sessionId, characterId)`. It posts to `` `${API_BASE}/api/rest` `` and returns `Observable<RestResponse>`.
   - Follow the pattern of the existing methods around lines 42–86.

7. **`frontend/src/app/components/game-console/game-console.component.ts`**
   - Add a `restAtInn()` handler. It calls `api.rest(...)`, then `this.charSvc.setCharacter(res.updatedCharacter)`, the same call used at lines 126, 153 and 190.
   - It then pushes a system entry such as "You rest and recover to full HP for N gold".
   - On error, show the "not enough gold" message.

8. **`frontend/src/app/components/game-console/game-console.component.html`**
   - Add a "Rest at Inn" button next to the Inventory button at line 9.
   - Disable it while the request is in flight.
   - Optionally disable it when `hp === max_hp` or gold is below the cost.

9. **`game-console.component.css`**
   - Optional styling for the button.
   - AGENTS.md says components are split into `.ts`, `.html`, `.css` and `.spec.ts`, with no inline templates.

10. **`game-console.component.spec.ts`**
    - Add tests with `GameApiService` as a Jasmine spy.
    - Cover success (the character is updated) and the insufficient-gold error.

`CharacterStateService.setCharacter` (`character-state.service.ts:50`) already exists, so the service needs no change. The character sheet updates through it.

## Docs to update in the same change
- The doc beside each changed file under `docs/code/...`, with links on both ends.
- A new doc for `routes/rest.ts`, with an entry in `code.md`. Then re-run `research-work/scripts/build-symbol-index.mjs`.
- `docs/PRD.md` §9, the API spec.
- `docs/flows/inventory.md`, or a new flow doc, if you want the feature documented as its own flow.
